description: WPN-first event-completion proposal for Turn Zero Games, CoreTCG, Aki Collectibles, ProjectCCG - Santa Ana, and ProjectCCG - Alhambra. Adds source-supported future recurring or dated events that are missing from the calendar, refreshes WPN source checked dates, and treats plain ProjectCCG WPN store 15983 as the Alhambra/main branch while keeping Santa Ana/OC separate.

fields.assessment_notes: Created as a separate ProjectCCG Alhambra/main-branch venue after official ProjectCCG site and WPN store 15983 both identify 39 S Garfield Ave, Alhambra. Treat Santa Ana/OC events separately under ProjectCCG - Santa Ana. WPN lists free Wednesday 5:00 PM Magic Commander Night at the Alhambra store; broader fit, Discord/community texture, and branch-specific social evidence still need a proper main pass.

positives: Official ProjectCCG site and WPN store 15983 both support an active Alhambra/main-branch identity.
WPN lists free Wednesday 5:00 PM Magic Commander Night with promo-on-entry language.
Separate venue record prevents Alhambra events from contaminating the Santa Ana/OC branch.
cautions: This is not a full main-store pass; branch-specific social, Discord, review, and in-store texture remain unresolved.
Twenty-mile distance makes it less immediately practical than closer Commander options unless the event/community quality proves strong.
open_questions: Is Wednesday Commander at Alhambra casual, proxy-friendly, and welcoming for solo arrival?
Do ProjectCCG social/Discord channels distinguish Alhambra from OC clearly enough for ongoing monitoring?
Are there additional Alhambra draft, prerelease, or special-event lanes outside the current WPN Commander row?
